title: Kamishiro Rui — A Director's Meticulous Magic〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Community Center

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, I'll start explaining how to use these devices.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was hoping to be there for the actual event, but I unfortunately have a scheduling conflict.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, that's okay. We really appreciate you providing us with the necessary devices on top of coming up with the effects.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, thanks for doing all this on such short notice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This was actually quite fun since it's a rare opportunity to come up with effects for a reading event.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Anyway, about these devices...
They're designed to be controlled using this remote.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You do have a long list of effects lined up for this event, but that shouldn't be a problem since everything can be done from here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
From this remote?
That's incredible...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Everything should go rather smoothly as long as the devices are all positioned correctly.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, it's just...
I'm wondering if I'll be able to control everything while reading at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Not to worry. I have that covered.
I'll explain while we test everything out.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we start with the snowmaker?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'll be using that when the dog reaches the first stop along his journey. The land of snow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'm thinking that you should let it start snowing right at the beginning of this scene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
This page in the book.
After you say, “The first stop along his journey was a chilly land of snow and ice.” How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think you'll want to set the stage early for an adventure through a winter wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I could be the one to activate it since Mochizuki will be reading that line.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I was also thinking that it'd be best to divide up the work. So, I've come up with a timeline of who is going to be doing what.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh...!
This will make things so much easier...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So, why don't we try testing it now?
Would you mind pressing the button for me, Mochizuki?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, you want me to do it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, since the best way to learn how it works is to actually try using it for yourself.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
O-Okay.
Umm... The button for the snow is... Oh, here it is!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's incredible. It's really snowing...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it's really pretty.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, this may actually be too much snow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Too much?
I think it's wonderful and leaves a nice impression...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that impression may be too strong.
Your listeners will likely start focusing on the snow instead of the story.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're going to be reading to first and second graders, yes? This is just the sort of thing which they'll find a little too captivating.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right. Some kids are really energetic and might even try to touch the snow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Precisely.
Thus, it may be wise to reduce the amount of snow that's produced.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It needs to feel more ephemeral.
To the point that it disappears before hitting the floor.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I hate to make you wait like this, but I promise to finish my adjustments in time for the event.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, it's no trouble...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I didn't realize that you'd go this far...
I'm surprised since I know next to nothing about directing performances.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. These sorts of effects are meant to help make the lead shine.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You can't do too much or too little. If you don't strike the right balance, you end up hurting instead of helping them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why it's a director's job to obsess over these sorts of things. It's also why directing is so fun.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I plan on doing everything I can to ensure the elementary schoolers who attend the event have a fantastic time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you very much...!
I promise to return the favor sometime after the event.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You don't need to do anything in return as long as you use these effects to put on a wonderful event.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Helping put on an incredible show is the best reward any director could ask for, after all.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Nod*
And we plan on making it a good event.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: R-Right. We promise to do our very best.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Then, I'll need to do a good job as well.
Would you mind meeting for another test run after I've finished making my adjustments?
